messages:
Alex Ruiz: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we're seeing a recurring 'stuttering' pattern on the streaming/chat endpoint: clients receive partial chunks, then ~2–6s silence, then the stream resumes. Root hypothesis: interaction between client reconnect/handshake behavior, server rate-limiter, and KV-cache warmup. Listing owners and timelines; please ack and update your tasks. cc @Maria Ng @Kevin Choi

Maria Ng: Ack. I'll own observability: add per-session inter-chunk delta histogram, session trace links, and an alert for >3s median gap over 5m. Dashboard + link by EOD Thu.

Kevin Choi: I'll dig into runtime handshake timeout and reconnect flow. Hypothesis: some reconnects create new sessions and trigger KV-cache cold starts, multiplying latency. Plan to run a canary with extended handshake window and measure. ETA: Fri AM.

Sarah Li: I'll prepare a draft customer note for beta customers if we confirm degradation and coordinate support for related tickets.

Alex Ruiz: Action items:
- Observability (Maria): inter_chunk_gap_ms metric, 95th pct alert >3000ms, session traces by node_id/model_variant — EOD Thu
- Runtime experiment (Kevin): extend handshake timeout on canary, add trace to detect if reconnect triggers full KV reseed — Fri AM
- Short-term mitigation (Alex): recommend client-side reconnect jitter + reduce rate-limiter aggressiveness for warm sessions; target SDK note & minor patch by Wed next week
- Customer comms (Sarah): prep draft once mitigations look good — Fri
- Follow-up sync (all): Mon 11:00 PT

Maria Ng: I'll also tag alerts with labels: "partial-response" and "timeout-gap" so we can correlate across incidents. Adding a view that ties gaps to node_id and model_variant to spot hardware/quantization correlations.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket #INC-9821 created and assigned to incidents.

Kevin Choi: Sample log showing a gap:
```
[2026-03-20T14:22:10Z] session=abc123 chunk=5 ok
[2026-03-20T14:22:11Z] session=abc123 chunk=6 ok
[2026-03-20T14:22:14Z] session=abc123 chunk=7 ok  <-- 3s gap
[2026-03-20T14:22:18Z] session=abc123 chunk=8 ok
```
Pattern: intermittent 1–4s gaps in clusters.

Alex Ruiz: Kevin, run a canary: set handshake timeout 2s -> 6s for a small fleet and compare inter_chunk_gap before/after. Instrument whether reconnect triggers a full KV cold-start; if so, that explains multiplicative tail.

Kevin Choi: Will run canary tomorrow. Also adding a trace flag to skip KV reseed for reconnects within 10s; we'll measure tail impact.

Maria Ng: I'll run a synthetic load: 1k concurrent sessions at 1 token/s to surface backpressure. If gaps appear, correlate to node_id and routing. Running mid-day tomorrow.

Sarah Li: If client-recommendation (jitter + capped exponential backoff) helps, can we release as a minor SDK patch? That would reduce customer retries.

Alex Ruiz: Yes; I'll prepare SDK guidance and push a small patch if Kevin's canary shows improvement.

Maria Ng: Dashboard link and alert configs will be posted here when ready.

Kevin Choi: ACK. I'll post canary results and a small diff for KV reseed-skip logic in-thread.

Maria Ng: ACK.

Sarah Li: ACK. I'll draft comms and hold until mitigations are validated.

Alex Ruiz: Ownership summary for INC-9821: Maria (obs & alerts), Kevin (runtime canary & KV behavior), Alex (short-term mitigation & SDK note), Sarah (customer comms). Please update the ticket with checkboxes and ETAs. Watch for correlated spikes on node_id or across regions; escalate to infra if seen. Next sync Mon 11:00 PT.
